"""Independent multiplexed concurrency experiment. Imports never register or use SSH."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import tarfile
import zipfile

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORKSPACE = BASE.parents[3]
EVIDENCE = WORKSPACE / 'evidence/2026-10-23/runpod-optimization'
OUT = EVIDENCE / 'mux-window'
IDLE_BASE = BASE.parent / 'idle'
IDLE_ROOT = EVIDENCE / 'idle'
NODE_REVISION = '87ad09c11807a78d4f8e3b2ad6088e6940e33261'
NODE_BUNDLE = '1317d767d1e6f1cc43320dea284818cc4fa246de7242c275d05408220aa270d0'
ANALYSIS_IDENTITY = '31e4dbc7af8c6e84e6099b76081837716870c47d4811d6d0db1757d594707e1f'
ANALYSIS_REVISION = '3fd86fe535fc0858e300e0337d4da154f622ae32'
PARK_ENV = 'VECTOR_DATA_PATH_MAX_PARK_NS'
PHASE = 'multiplexed-logical-concurrency-configuration-control'
CONTROLLERS = ('common.py', 'register.py', 'matrix.py', 'test_guards.py',
               'build.py', 'bundle-load.py', 'deploy-load.py')
_IDLE = None
_RUNNER = None


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    path = Path(path)
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), 'Regular non-symlink input required: ' + str(path))
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def read(path):
    digest(path)
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def save_new(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')


def idle_module():
    """Only pinned code is imported; binding is local to this controller process."""
    global _IDLE
    if _IDLE is None:
        plan = read(IDLE_ROOT / 'plan.json')
        require(set(plan['controllerSha256']) == {'common.py', 'register.py', 'matrix.py', 'test_guards.py',
                                                  'build.py', 'bundle-node.py', 'deploy-node.py'},
                'Frozen idle controller closure differs')
        for name, expected in plan['controllerSha256'].items():
            require(digest(IDLE_BASE / name) == expected, 'Frozen idle controller changed: ' + name)
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mux_window_frozen_idle', IDLE_BASE / 'common.py')
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        _IDLE = module
    return _IDLE


def runner_module():
    """A second module instance prevents dynamic W checks from altering prerequisite checks."""
    global _RUNNER
    if _RUNNER is None:
        p = idle_module().capacity_module()
        original = p.frozen_parent()
        path = Path(original.__file__)
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mux_window_independent_runner', path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        _RUNNER = module
    return _RUNNER


def tasks(kind):
    if kind == 'pilot':
        return [{'id': 'mw-pilot-10000-w256', 'cohort': 'pilot', 'rate': 10000,
                 'arrivals': 350000, 'workers': 256, 'transportMode': 'multiplexed',
                 'phase': 'multiplexed256-strict350k-canonical-pilot', 'repetition': 1}]
    require(kind == 'matrix', 'Unknown mux-window plan kind')
    return [{'id': f'mw-window-26000-w{workers}-r{rep}', 'cohort': f'w{workers}', 'rate': 26000,
             'arrivals': 350000, 'workers': workers, 'transportMode': 'multiplexed',
             'phase': PHASE, 'repetition': rep}
            for rep in (1, 2) for workers in (128, 256)]


def concurrency(workers):
    require(type(workers) is int and workers in (128, 256), 'Only logical128/256 are preregistered')
    return {'logicalWorkers': workers, 'maximumLogicalInFlight': workers, 'queuePerWorker': 64,
            'totalClientFifoCapacity': workers * 64, 'physicalSessions': 1, 'clientDrivers': 1,
            'requiredActualClientPendingCapacity': workers}


def fixed_configuration(source):
    """Identical node and physical-transport configuration in both concurrency arms."""
    fixed = {**source, 'clientTransportMode': 'multiplexed', 'clientSessionCount': 1,
             'nodeDataPathMaxParkNs': 1000000, 'nodeDataPathIdlePolicyVersion': 1,
             'nodeDataPathIdleAgentMaxYields': 20, 'nodeDataPathIdleMinParkNs': 1000,
             'driverIdleMaxParkNs': 1000000}
    fixed['idleStrategy'] = ('Independent node data-path Backoff: driver(10,5,1000,1000000), '
                             'archive/consensus/service(10,20,1000,1000000); load policy unchanged')
    return fixed


def check_runtime(configuration, load, workers):
    concurrency(workers)
    expected = {'workers': workers, 'clientDriverMode': 'shared', 'clientDriverCount': 1,
                'clientTransportMode': 'multiplexed', 'clientSessionCount': 1,
                'clientAeronMode': 'one-session-one-network-owner', 'clientPendingCapacity': workers,
                'clientNakUnicastDelayNs': 1000, 'clientNakUnicastRetryDelayRatio': 100}
    for record in (configuration, load):
        for name, value in expected.items():
            require(type(record.get(name)) is type(value) and record[name] == value,
                    'Actual load transport/window differs: ' + name)
    require(configuration.get('maxServiceRequestsInFlight') == workers
            and configuration.get('queueCapacityPerWorker') == load.get('queueCapacityPerWorker') == 64,
            'Logical in-flight/FIFO configuration differs')


def strict_pilot(result, load, configuration):
    check_runtime(configuration, load, 256)
    require(result.get('passed') is True and result.get('canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified') is True
            and result.get('measurementValid') is True and load.get('generatorTimingInvalid') is False,
            'Strict pilot must be canonical and timing-valid')
    require(type(load.get('scheduledArrivals')) is int and load['scheduledArrivals'] == 350000
            and type(load.get('confirmedAcceptedCommands')) is int and load['confirmedAcceptedCommands'] == 350000,
            'Strict pilot must accept every350k arrival')
    for name in ('clientNotSentCommands', 'businessRejectedCommands', 'serverErrors', 'unknownAtInitialDeadline',
                 'unresolvedFinal', 'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount'):
        require(type(load.get(name)) is int and load[name] == 0, 'Strict pilot nonzero/missing count: ' + name)


def assess_idle_completion(plan, retained, completion):
    expected = idle_module().tasks('matrix')
    require(plan.get('kind') == 'matrix' and plan.get('trials') == expected, 'Original idle A/B/A/B tasks changed')
    require([row['id'] for row in retained] == [row['id'] for row in expected]
            and [row['id'] for row in completion.get('trials', [])] == [row['id'] for row in expected],
            'All four terminal idle attempts and completion event are required')
    require(all(row.get('terminal') is True and row.get('configurationVerified') is True
                and row.get('rawArchiveVerified') is True and row.get('analysisVerified') is True
                and row.get('ownedStopped') is True for row in retained),
            'Idle terminal/configuration/raw/archive/analysis/cleanup evidence incomplete')
    def utc(value):
        require(isinstance(value, str), 'Missing completion/cleanup timestamp')
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        require(dt.tzinfo is not None, 'Timestamp must include timezone')
        return dt
    require(utc(completion.get('timestamp')) >= max(utc(row[name]) for row in retained
                for name in ('terminalCompletedAt', 'ownedStoppedAt')), 'Idle completion timeline predates terminal cleanup')
    # No stability or success gate: prior failures must remain their actual outcome.
    return retained


def artifact_prerequisites():
    """Artifact-only preparation needs the idle registration, not its completed results."""
    idle = idle_module()
    plan = read(IDLE_ROOT / 'plan.json')
    require(plan['trials'] == idle.tasks('matrix'), 'Require original registered idle plan')
    require(plan['node']['revision'] == NODE_REVISION and plan['node']['bundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE,
            'Fixed node87ad artifact changed')
    require(plan['analysisIdentitySha256'] == ANALYSIS_IDENTITY
            and plan['postprocessor']['revision'] == ANALYSIS_REVISION, 'Independent31e4 analyzer changed')
    p = idle.capacity_module()
    require(p.analysis_identity() == plan['postprocessor'], 'Independent postprocessor source/runtime differs')
    return {'node': plan['node'], 'nodeBuild': plan['build'], 'nodeBuildTools': plan['buildTools'],
            'observer': plan['observer'], 'probe': plan['probe'], 'postprocessor': plan['postprocessor'],
            'analysisIdentitySha256': plan['analysisIdentitySha256'],
            'preparedSnapshotSha256': plan['preparedSnapshotSha256']}


def prerequisites():
    """Hard registration/load gate: current idle matrix must be completely terminal."""
    idle = idle_module()
    plan_path = IDLE_ROOT / 'plan.json'
    plan = read(plan_path)
    identity = idle.validate_plan(plan)
    prior = artifact_prerequisites()
    inputs = {}
    def remember(path):
        path = Path(path)
        key = str(path.relative_to(WORKSPACE))
        value = digest(path)
        require(key not in inputs or inputs[key] == value, 'Prerequisite changed during validation')
        inputs[key] = value
    for path in (plan_path, IDLE_ROOT / 'timeline.jsonl', IDLE_ROOT / 'node-release.json'):
        remember(path)
    retained = []
    for task in plan['trials']:
        directory = IDLE_ROOT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        checked = idle.checked_trial(task, identity, prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
        trial = read(directory / 'trial.json')
        summary = read(directory / 'analysis-summary.json')
        rows = [row for row in summary['trials'] if row['id'] == task['id']]
        require(len(rows) == 1, 'Missing/duplicate immutable idle analysis row')
        for name in rows[0]['inputSha256']:
            remember(directory / name)
        for name in ('configuration-verification.json', 'receipt.json', 'arrivals.csv.gz', 'arrivals-archive.json',
                     'postprocess.json', 'postprocessor-identity.json', 'analysis-summary.json', 'analysis-capacity.csv',
                     'all-owned-processes-stopped.json'):
            remember(directory / name)
        for name in ('campaign.json', 'deployment.json', 'deployment-manifest.json'):
            remember(IDLE_ROOT / task['cohort'] / name)
        retained.append({**checked, 'state': trial['state'], 'terminal': bool(trial.get('completedAt')),
                         'configurationVerified': True, 'rawArchiveVerified': True,
                         'analysisVerified': True, 'ownedStopped': True,
                         'terminalCompletedAt': trial['completedAt'],
                         'ownedStoppedAt': read(directory / 'all-owned-processes-stopped.json')['timestamp']})
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in (IDLE_ROOT / 'timeline.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    completed = [event for event in events if event.get('action') == 'node-idle-matrix-completed']
    require(len(completed) == 1, 'Exactly one completed idle matrix timeline is required')
    assess_idle_completion(plan, retained, completed[0])
    return {**prior, 'retainedIdleAttempts': retained, 'completionEvent': completed[0],
            'inputs': dict(sorted(inputs.items())),
            'scope': 'All four earlier idle attempts retain their terminal classifications, including invalid outcomes. Complete raw/archive/config/leader/31e4/owned-cleanup/timeline required; stability is not required.'}


def load_class_diff(node, load):
    """Recompute all archive/JAR entry bytes; declarations alone are insufficient."""
    c = idle_module().capacity_module().frozen_parent()
    for release in (node, load):
        c.archive_manifest(release)
    def jars(release):
        output = {}
        with tarfile.open(release['archive']) as archive:
            for member in archive.getmembers():
                if member.isfile() and member.name.startswith('dist/cluster/lib/') and member.name.endswith('.jar'):
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive.extractfile(member).read())) as jar:
                        names = jar.namelist()
                        require(len(names) == len(set(names)), 'Duplicate JAR entry')
                        output[Path(member.name).name] = {name: hashlib.sha256(jar.read(name)).hexdigest()
                                                        for name in names if not name.endswith('/')}
        return output
    before, after = jars(node), jars(load)
    require(before and set(before) == set(after), 'Node/load dependency JAR sets differ')
    changes = []
    families = ('io/vectormatch/cluster/RemoteCapacityExperiment', 'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports')
    for jar in before:
        if not jar.startswith('cluster-'):
            require(before[jar] == after[jar], 'Core/dependency JAR entry differs: ' + jar)
            continue
        for entry in sorted(set(before[jar]) | set(after[jar])):
            if before[jar].get(entry) == after[jar].get(entry):
                continue
            require(any(entry == family + '.class' or entry.startswith(family + '$') for family in families),
                    'Unrelated cluster bytecode differs: ' + entry)
            changes.append(entry)
    require(changes and any('/MultiplexedLoadTransports' in entry for entry in changes), 'New mux bytecode required')
    return {'changedClusterEntries': sorted(changes), 'otherJarEntriesUnchanged': True,
            'scope': 'Actual named JAR entry bytes versus fixed node87ad; only capacity/mux class families differ. ZIP timestamps excluded.'}


def artifact_inputs(prior, require_upload=True):
    c = idle_module().capacity_module().frozen_parent()
    node = read(IDLE_ROOT / 'node-release.json')
    require(node == prior['node'] and node['revision'] == NODE_REVISION and node['bundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE,
            'Fixed three-node artifact changed')
    node_manifest = c.archive_manifest(node)
    require(read(IDLE_ROOT / 'node-deployment-manifest.json') == node_manifest, 'Fixed node manifest changed')
    node_upload = read(IDLE_ROOT / 'node-upload-receipt.json')
    require(node_upload['bundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE and len(node_upload['nodes']) == 3
            and {row['node'] for row in node_upload['nodes']} == {0, 1, 2}
            and all(row['verified'] is True and row['nodeRevision'] == NODE_REVISION
                    and row['files'] == node_manifest['files'] and row['launcherTest']['exitCode'] == 0
                    for row in node_upload['nodes']), 'Fixed node upload/launcher proof differs')
    load = read(BASE / 'load-release.json')
    build = read(BASE / 'build.json')
    require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', load['revision']) and load['revision'] != NODE_REVISION
            and build['revision'] == load['revision'] and build.get('sourceRevisionExplicitlyPinned') is True,
            'Require one new explicit committed load artifact for both arms')
    require(load['root'] == '/opt/vectormatch/optimization-load-releases/' + load['revision'], 'Unexpected load release path')
    build_root = Path(build['root']).resolve()
    require(build_root.parent == BASE and build_root.name == 'build-' + load['revision'], 'Unexpected load build path')
    require(digest(build['sourceArchivePath']) == build['sourceArchiveSha256'], 'Load source archive changed')
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(load)
    require(read(OUT / 'load-release.json') == load and read(OUT / 'load-deployment-manifest.json') == manifest
            and manifest['role'] == 'capacity-mux-window-load-only'
            and manifest['comparedAgainstNodeRevision'] == manifest['fixedNodeRevision'] == NODE_REVISION
            and manifest['fixedNodeBundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE
            and manifest['sourceArchiveSha256'] == build['sourceArchiveSha256'], 'Load manifest differs')
    actual_diff = load_class_diff(node, load)
    require(actual_diff['changedClusterEntries'] == manifest['changedClusterEntries'], 'Declared load class diff differs')
    test = read(OUT / 'tool-validation/java-tests.json')
    require(test['revision'] == load['revision'] and test['exitCode'] == test['failures'] == test['skipped'] == 0
            and type(test['tests']) is int and test['tests'] > 0
            and test['sourceArchiveSha256'] == build['sourceArchiveSha256'], 'Full isolated load test proof is not green')
    tools = {}
    for name in ('scripts/check-capacity-leader.py', 'scripts/verify-capacity-config.py',
                 'scripts/analyze-capacity.py', 'scripts/archive-capacity-arrivals.py'):
        tools[name] = {'path': str(build_root / name), 'sha256': digest(build_root / name)}
        if name != 'scripts/verify-capacity-config.py':
            require(tools[name]['sha256'] == prior['nodeBuildTools'][name]['sha256'], 'Unrelated tool changed: ' + name)
    if require_upload:
        uploaded = read(OUT / 'load-upload-receipt.json')
        require(uploaded['bundleSha256'] == load['bundleSha256'] and len(uploaded['nodes']) == 1,
                'Require immutable load upload to only node2')
        row = uploaded['nodes'][0]
        require(type(row['node']) is int and row['node'] == 2 and row['verified'] is True
                and row['loadRevision'] == load['revision'] and row['files'] == manifest['files']
                and row['launcherTest']['exitCode'] == 0, 'Load upload/launcher proof differs')
    return {'node': node, 'load': load, 'nodeBuild': prior['nodeBuild'], 'build': build, 'buildTools': tools,
            'observer': prior['observer'], 'probe': prior['probe'], 'postprocessor': prior['postprocessor'],
            'analysisIdentitySha256': prior['analysisIdentitySha256'], 'loadClassDiffAudit': actual_diff}


def configure(c, identity):
    c.RELEASE = identity['node']['root']
    c.LOAD_RELEASE = identity['load']['root']
    c.BUILD_TOOLS = identity['buildTools']
    c.ATTRIBUTION_ROOT = identity['observer']['root']
    c.SOCKET_PROBE = identity['probe']
    c.COMMON.update({'VECTOR_DIST_ROOT': c.RELEASE + '/dist', 'VECTOR_MAX_CLUSTER_SESSIONS': '256',
                     'VECTOR_MAX_HEAP': '2g', 'VECTOR_OUTBOX_CAPACITY': '800000',
                     'VECTOR_STATE_PROFILE': 'capacity-350k-v1', 'VECTOR_SOCKET_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES': '131072',
                     'VECTOR_DRIVER_THREADING_MODE': 'SHARED', 'VECTOR_NAK_UNICAST_DELAY_NS': '1000'})
    c.COMMON.pop(PARK_ENV, None)
    c.LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS = ['-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.driver=shared', '-Daeron.nak.unicast.delay=1000',
                            '-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.transport=multiplexed']
    c.LOAD_IDENTITY = {'loadGeneratorRevision': identity['load']['revision'],
                       'loadGeneratorBundleSha256': identity['load']['bundleSha256'], 'loadGeneratorRelease': c.LOAD_RELEASE,
                       'attributionObserverIdentity': identity['observer']['identity'],
                       'effectiveBufferProbeSha256': identity['probe']['sha256']}
    original = getattr(c, 'mux_window_original_service', c.service)
    c.mux_window_original_service = original
    c.service = lambda node, role, action, env: original(node, role, action,
                    {**env, PARK_ENV: '1000000'} if role == 'node' else env)


def checked_trial(root, task, identity, prepared):
    """Independent dynamic-window checks; the frozen parent assumes W128 and is not reused here."""
    p = idle_module().capacity_module()
    c = p.frozen_parent()
    directory = root / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
    trial = read(directory / 'trial.json')
    receipt = read(directory / 'receipt.json')
    require(bool(trial.get('completedAt')), 'Trial is not terminal')
    c.checked_stop_receipt(directory / 'all-owned-processes-stopped.json', trial['state'])
    for name in ('fixed-leader-check.json', 'configuration-verification.json'):
        require(read(directory / name)['passed'] is True, 'Required verification failed: ' + name)
    require(trial['release'] == identity['node']['root'] and trial['deploymentRevision'] == NODE_REVISION
            and trial['deploymentBundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE, 'Actual node artifact differs')
    for key in ('rate', 'arrivals', 'workers', 'phase', 'repetition'):
        require(type(trial.get(key)) is type(task[key]) and trial[key] == task[key], 'Task differs: ' + key)
    for name, key in [('loadGeneratorRevision', 'revision'), ('loadGeneratorBundleSha256', 'bundleSha256'),
                      ('loadGeneratorRelease', 'root')]:
        require(trial[name] == identity['load'][key], 'Actual load artifact differs: ' + name)
    configuration = read(directory / 'configuration.json')
    load = read(directory / 'load-result.json')
    check_runtime(configuration, load, task['workers'])
    require(configuration['preparedSnapshotSha256'] == digest(directory / 'prepared-snapshot.bin') == prepared,
            'Prepared state differs')
    require(configuration['profile'] == 'extended-350k-256'
            and configuration['expectedStateProfile'] == 'capacity-350k-v1'
            and configuration['scheduledArrivals'] == 350000 and configuration['ratePerSecond'] == task['rate']
            and configuration['seededMakerQuantity'] == 380000 and configuration['seededQuotePerBuyer'] == 1900000000
            and configuration['initialResultCachePerProducer'] == 1024 and configuration['validationTimeoutSeconds'] == 600,
            'Fixture/profile/timeouts differ')
    campaign = read(root / task['cohort'] / 'campaign.json')
    require(campaign['concurrencyConfiguration'] == concurrency(task['workers'])
            and trial['fixedNodeConfiguration'] == campaign['fixed'], 'Registered fixed/concurrency configuration differs')
    fixed = trial['fixedNodeConfiguration']
    require(fixed == fixed_configuration(fixed) and fixed['nodeHeap'] == fixed['loadHeap'] == '2g'
            and fixed['syncLevel'] == 2 and fixed['maxClusterSessions'] == 256 and fixed['outboxCapacity'] == 800000
            and fixed['maxRetainedOrders'] == 360000 and fixed['driverThreadingArgument'] == 'SHARED'
            and fixed['socketReceiveBufferArgumentBytes'] == 131072
            and fixed['nakUnicastDelayNs'] == fixed['clientNakUnicastDelayNs'] == 1000
            and fixed['nakUnicastRetryDelayRatio'] == 100, 'Fixed server/transport configuration differs')
    analysis = p.check_trial_analysis(directory, identity['postprocessor'])
    summary = read(directory / 'analysis-summary.json')
    rows = [row for row in summary['trials'] if row['id'] == task['id']]
    require(len(rows) == 1, 'Missing/duplicate immutable analysis row')
    row = rows[0]
    for name, expected in row['inputSha256'].items():
        require(Path(name).name == name and digest(directory / name) == expected, 'Analyzed raw input differs: ' + name)
    require(row['inputSha256'] == read(directory / 'postprocess.json')['analysis']['inputSha256Before'],
            'Analyzer input closure differs')
    archive = read(directory / 'arrivals-archive.json')
    require(archive['rawFile'] == 'arrivals.csv' and archive['archiveFile'] == 'arrivals.csv.gz' and archive['format'] == 'gzip'
            and archive['rawSha256'] == row['inputSha256']['arrivals.csv']
            and archive['compressedBytes'] == (directory / 'arrivals.csv.gz').stat().st_size
            and archive['compressedSha256'] == digest(directory / 'arrivals.csv.gz'), 'Lossless archive differs')
    canonical = guarded = False
    if (directory / 'result.json').exists():
        result = read(directory / 'result.json')
        require(receipt['exitCode'] == 0 and result.get('passed') is True
                and result.get('canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified') is True, 'Unexpected result failure')
        check_runtime(configuration, result, task['workers'])
        canonical = True
    else:
        require(receipt['exitCode'] != 0 and c.expected_unknown_failure(read(directory / 'failure.json'), load),
                'Unexpected failure; halt after preserving raw')
        guarded = True
    return {'id': task['id'], 'workers': task['workers'], 'concurrencyConfiguration': concurrency(task['workers']),
            'classification': row['classification'], 'measurementValid': row.get('measurementValid'),
            'canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified': canonical, 'expectedCanonicalIncompleteUnknownGuard': guarded,
            'capacityEligible': canonical and row.get('measurementValid') is True,
            'preparedSnapshotSha256': prepared, 'summarySha256': digest(root / task['cohort'] / 'analysis/summary.json'),
            'reportedArrivalWindowConfirmations': load.get('confirmedWithinArrivalWindow'),
            'reportedArrivalWindowConfirmationsPerSecond': load.get('confirmedWithinArrivalWindowPerSecond'),
            'reportedCountsScope': 'Client-reported diagnostic counts on canonical-incomplete failure; never validated business success.',
            'unknownAtInitialDeadline': load.get('unknownAtInitialDeadline'), 'unresolvedFinal': load.get('unresolvedFinal'),
            'archiveManifestSha256': digest(directory / 'arrivals-archive.json'), 'analysisVerification': analysis}


def controller_hashes():
    return {name: digest(BASE / name) for name in CONTROLLERS}


def validate_plan(plan):
    prior = prerequisites()
    require(prior == plan['prerequisites'], 'Frozen idle evidence changed')
    identity = artifact_inputs(prior)
    require(all(plan[name] == value for name, value in identity.items()), 'Artifact/analysis identity changed')
    require(plan['trials'] == tasks(plan['kind']) and plan['controllerSha256'] == controller_hashes(), 'Task/controller changed')
    require(set(plan['campaignSha256']) == {task['cohort'] for task in plan['trials']}, 'Campaign closure differs')
    for cohort, records in plan['campaignSha256'].items():
        require(set(records) == {'campaign.json', 'deployment.json', 'deployment-manifest.json'}, 'Campaign proof closure differs')
        for name, expected in records.items():
            require(digest(OUT / cohort / name) == expected, 'Registered campaign changed: ' + cohort + '/' + name)
    require(plan['preparedSnapshotSha256'] == prior['preparedSnapshotSha256']
            and plan['loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds'] == plan['validationTimeoutSeconds'] == 600
            and plan['noHiddenReissue'] is True and plan['requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial'] is True
            and plan['newResources'] == 0, 'Timeout/state/no-replay policy changed')
    if plan['kind'] == 'matrix':
        pilot_plan = read(OUT / 'pilot-plan.json')
        proof = plan['pilotPrerequisite']
        require(digest(OUT / 'pilot-plan.json') == proof['planSha256']
                and all(pilot_plan[name] == value for name, value in identity.items()), 'Pilot artifact differs')
        task = tasks('pilot')[0]
        require(checked_trial(OUT, task, identity, prior['preparedSnapshotSha256']) == proof['trial'], 'Pilot evidence changed')
        directory = OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        strict_pilot(read(directory / 'result.json'), read(directory / 'load-result.json'), read(directory / 'configuration.json'))
        for name, expected in proof['proofs'].items():
            relative = Path(name)
            require(not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts and digest(OUT / relative) == expected,
                    'Strict pilot proof changed: ' + name)
    return identity


def fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, states):
    class ReadOnlyAdapter:
        def configure(self, supplied, mode): pass
        def __getattr__(self, name): return getattr(c, name)
    return idle_module().capacity_module().fresh_owned_stopped(ReadOnlyAdapter(), identity, states)


def run_task(task, plan, identity):
    p = idle_module().capacity_module()
    c = runner_module()
    c.validate_identity = validate_plan
    c.configure = lambda supplied, mode: configure(c, supplied) if mode == 'multiplexed' else require(False, 'Only multiplexed allowed')
    c.checked_trial = checked_trial
    c.analyze_and_archive = lambda supplied, node_identity: p.analyze_and_archive(c, supplied, node_identity, identity['postprocessor'])
    row = c.run_task(OUT, task, plan, identity, plan['preparedSnapshotSha256'])
    if plan['kind'] == 'pilot':
        directory = OUT / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']
        strict_pilot(read(directory / 'result.json'), read(directory / 'load-result.json'), read(directory / 'configuration.json'))
    return row

        return
    prior = p.prerequisites()

                                             'postprocess.json', 'postprocessor-identity.json',
                                             'analysis-summary.json', 'analysis-capacity.csv')}}
    rows = p.tasks(args.kind)
    for task in rows:
        p.require(not (p.OUT / task['cohort']).exists(), 'Partial registration/trial exists; inspect without overwrite')
    budget = c.budget(900 if args.kind == 'pilot' else 3000)
    source = p.read(p.IDLE_ROOT / 'park1000000/campaign.json')
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(identity['node'])
    fixed = p.fixed_configuration(source['fixed'])
    for task in rows:
        cohort = p.OUT / task['cohort']
        if cohort.exists():
            continue
        campaign = {**source, 'registeredAtUtc': c.now(), 'fixed': fixed,
                    'screeningRates': [task['rate']], 'screeningWorkers': task['workers'],
                    'concurrencySweep': [task['workers']], 'concurrencyConfiguration': p.concurrency(task['workers']),
                    'preparedSnapshotSha256': prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'], 'postprocessor': identity['postprocessor'],
                    'analysisIdentitySha256': identity['analysisIdentitySha256'], 'prerequisites': prior,
                    'scope': 'Same new load artifact in both arms; logical W128/W256, one session/driver, Q64 so FIFO8192/16384 also changes. Fixed node87ad explicit1ms park, NAK1000/retry100,2g/sync2/fixture. Finite configuration comparison, not pure window-only factor or unconstrained engine capacity. All failed attempts retained.'}
        p.save_new(cohort / 'campaign.json', campaign)
        p.save_new(cohort / 'deployment.json', identity['node'])
        p.save_new(cohort / 'deployment-manifest.json', manifest)
    campaign_sha = {task['cohort']: {filename: p.digest(p.OUT / task['cohort'] / filename)
                                    for filename in ('campaign.json', 'deployment.json', 'deployment-manifest.json')}
                    for task in rows}
    p.save_new(p.OUT / name, {'registeredAtUtc': c.now(), 'kind': args.kind, **identity, 'prerequisites': prior,
                             'preparedSnapshotSha256': prior['preparedSnapshotSha256'], 'pilotPrerequisite': pilot,
                             'trials': rows, 'controllerSha256': p.controller_hashes(), 'campaignSha256': campaign_sha,
                             'budget': budget, 'loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds': 600, 'validationTimeoutSeconds': 600,
                             'localFreeBytesPerTrialMinimum': 1073741824, 'noHiddenReissue': True,
                             'requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial': True, 'newResources': 0,
                             'scope': 'Multiplexed concurrency-configuration factor128/256, including FIFO8192/16384. Same new load and fixed node87ad1ms park in all arms; independent31e4 analysis. Prior idle outcomes unchanged.'})
    print('MUX_WINDOW_REGISTERED_NO_LOAD_SUBMITTED', args.kind, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Explicit registered mux-window runner. Importing submits nothing."""
import argparse
import shutil
import common as p


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=('pilot', 'matrix'), default='matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    p.require(args.execute, 'Root must review and explicitly --execute')
    plan = p.read(p.OUT / ('pilot-plan.json' if args.kind == 'pilot' else 'plan.json'))
    p.require(plan['kind'] == args.kind, 'Registered kind differs')
    identity = p.validate_plan(plan)
    c = p.runner_module()
    c.budget(900 if args.kind == 'pilot' else 3000)
    p.require(shutil.disk_usage(p.OUT).free >= 1024 ** 3, 'At least1GiB free evidence space required')
    p.configure(c, identity)
    p.save_new(p.OUT / (args.kind + '-legacy-owned-stopped.json'), c.verify_historical_owned_stopped(identity))
    states = [row['state'] for row in plan['prerequisites']['retainedIdleAttempts']]
    idle_plan = p.read(p.IDLE_ROOT / 'plan.json')
    states += [row['state'] for row in idle_plan['prerequisites']['retainedCapacityAttempts']]
    old_capacity_plan = p.read(p.EVIDENCE / 'pipeline-capacity/plan.json')
    states += [row['state'] for row in old_capacity_plan['prerequisites']['branch']['originalOutcomes']]
    idle_pilot = p.idle_module().tasks('pilot')[0]
    states.append(p.read(p.IDLE_ROOT / idle_pilot['cohort'] / 'runs' / idle_pilot['id'] / 'trial.json')['state'])
    if args.kind == 'matrix':
        pilot = p.tasks('pilot')[0]
        states.append(p.read(p.OUT / pilot['cohort'] / 'runs' / pilot['id'] / 'trial.json')['state'])
    p.save_new(p.OUT / (args.kind + '-prior-owned-stopped.json'), p.fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, states))
    results = []
    for task in plan['trials']:
        c.budget((len(plan['trials']) - len(results)) * 750)
        p.require(shutil.disk_usage(p.OUT).free >= 1024 ** 3, 'Full export local-space guard failed')
        if results:
            previous = plan['trials'][len(results) - 1]
            state = p.read(p.OUT / previous['cohort'] / 'runs' / previous['id'] / 'trial.json')['state']
            p.save_new(p.OUT / ('before-' + task['id'] + '-owned-stopped.json'),
                       p.fresh_owned_stopped(c, identity, [state]))
        results.append(p.run_task(task, plan, identity))
    c.OUT = p.OUT
    c.record('mux-window-' + args.kind + '-completed', trials=results, budget=c.budget(0),
             scope='All exact registered attempts retained with raw gzip, source/config/leader/31e4 and owned cleanup. Invalid and overload outcomes remain unchanged.')
    print('MUX_WINDOW_PLAN_COMPLETE_REVIEW_RESULTS', args.kind, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Local preparation guards. No load, SSH, registration or active raw scan."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import tarfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import zipfile
import common as p
import register
import matrix


def runtime(workers):
    value = {'workers': workers, 'clientDriverMode': 'shared', 'clientDriverCount': 1,
             'clientTransportMode': 'multiplexed', 'clientSessionCount': 1,
             'clientAeronMode': 'one-session-one-network-owner', 'clientPendingCapacity': workers,
             'clientNakUnicastDelayNs': 1000, 'clientNakUnicastRetryDelayRatio': 100,
             'maxServiceRequestsInFlight': workers, 'queueCapacityPerWorker': 64}
    return value


def pilot():
    configuration = runtime(256)
    result = {**configuration, 'passed': True, 'canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified': True, 'measurementValid': True}
    load = {**configuration, 'generatorTimingInvalid': False, 'scheduledArrivals': 350000,
            'confirmedAcceptedCommands': 350000, 'clientNotSentCommands': 0, 'businessRejectedCommands': 0,
            'serverErrors': 0, 'unknownAtInitialDeadline': 0, 'unresolvedFinal': 0,
            'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount': 0}
    return result, load, configuration


def load_archive(path, changed=None, core=b'fixed-core'):
    classes = {'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class': b'fixed-node87ad',
               'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterClient.class': b'fixed-client',
               'io/vectormatch/cluster/RemoteCapacityExperiment.class': b'old-capacity',
               'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports.class': b'old-mux'}
    classes.update(changed or {})
    jars = {}
    for name, entries in [('cluster-0.jar', classes), ('core-0.jar', {'core.class': core})]:
        data = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(data, 'w') as jar:
            for entry, content in entries.items():
                jar.writestr(entry, content)
        jars['dist/cluster/lib/' + name] = data.getvalue()
    with tarfile.open(path, 'w:gz') as archive:
        for name, content in jars.items():
            member = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
            member.size = len(content)
            archive.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(content))
    return {'archive': str(path)}


class Guards(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_factor_order_and_composite_fifo_change_are_explicit(self):
        rows = p.tasks('matrix')
        self.assertEqual([128, 256, 128, 256], [row['workers'] for row in rows])
        self.assertEqual(4, len({row['id'] for row in rows}))
        self.assertTrue(all(row['rate'] == 26000 and row['arrivals'] == 350000
                            and row['transportMode'] == 'multiplexed' for row in rows))
        self.assertEqual([8192, 16384], [p.concurrency(w)['totalClientFifoCapacity'] for w in (128, 256)])
        self.assertEqual([1, 1], [p.concurrency(w)['physicalSessions'] for w in (128, 256)])

    def test_pilot_is_one_B256_full350k_35second_window(self):
        rows = p.tasks('pilot')
        self.assertEqual(1, len(rows))
        self.assertEqual(256, rows[0]['workers'])
        self.assertEqual(35, rows[0]['arrivals'] / rows[0]['rate'])
        p.strict_pilot(*pilot())

    def test_initial_unknown_rejects_pilot_even_when_eventually_all_accepted(self):
        result, load, config = pilot()
        load['unknownAtInitialDeadline'] = 1
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            p.strict_pilot(result, load, config)

    def test_strict_pilot_rejects_loss_business_error_timing_or_canonical_failure(self):
        for name in ('clientNotSentCommands', 'businessRejectedCommands', 'serverErrors', 'unresolvedFinal',
                     'schedulerLatenessAboveLimitCount'):
            result, load, config = pilot()
            load[name] = 1
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.strict_pilot(result, load, config)
        for target, name, bad in [('load', 'confirmedAcceptedCommands', 349999),
                                  ('load', 'generatorTimingInvalid', True),
                                  ('result', 'canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified', False)]:
            result, load, config = pilot()
            {'load': load, 'result': result}[target][name] = bad
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.strict_pilot(result, load, config)

    def test_actual_pending_capacity_is_required_for_both_arms_not_just_w256(self):
        for workers in (128, 256):
            config = runtime(workers)
            p.check_runtime(config, dict(config), workers)
            for bad in (None, 128 if workers == 256 else 256, True, str(workers)):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    p.check_runtime({**config, 'clientPendingCapacity': bad}, config, workers)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    p.check_runtime(config, {**config, 'clientPendingCapacity': bad}, workers)

    def test_one_driver_one_session_and_nak_actuals_cannot_be_mislabeled(self):
        config = runtime(256)
        for name, bad in [('clientDriverCount', 256), ('clientSessionCount', 256),
                          ('clientTransportMode', 'direct'), ('clientNakUnicastDelayNs', 100000),
                          ('clientAeronMode', 'one-independent-Aeron-per-client'), ('workers', True)]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.check_runtime(config, {**config, name: bad}, 256)

    def test_fixed_node_and_physical_transport_do_not_depend_on_worker_count(self):
        source = {'nodeHeap': '2g', 'syncLevel': 2, 'driverIdleMaxSpins': 10, 'driverIdleMaxYields': 5,
                  'nakUnicastDelayNs': 1000, 'queuePerWorker': 64}
        before = dict(source)
        fixed = p.fixed_configuration(source)
        self.assertEqual(before, source)
        self.assertEqual(1000000, fixed['nodeDataPathMaxParkNs'])
        self.assertEqual(1000000, fixed['driverIdleMaxParkNs'])
        self.assertEqual(20, fixed['nodeDataPathIdleAgentMaxYields'])
        self.assertEqual(5, fixed['driverIdleMaxYields'])
        self.assertEqual(1, fixed['clientSessionCount'])
        self.assertEqual(fixed, p.fixed_configuration(fixed))

    def test_node_park_is_explicit_and_not_added_to_load_environment_or_flags(self):
        calls = []
        class Runner:
            COMMON = {p.PARK_ENV: 'stale'}
            def service(self, node, role, action, env):
                calls.append((role, env))
        identity = {'node': {'root': '/fixed-node87'}, 'load': {'root': '/new-load', 'revision': 'a' * 40,
                    'bundleSha256': 'b' * 64}, 'buildTools': {}, 'observer': {'root': '/observer', 'identity': 'observer'},
                    'probe': {'sha256': 'probe'}}
        c = Runner()
        p.configure(c, identity)
        self.assertNotIn(p.PARK_ENV, c.COMMON)
        self.assertTrue(all('dataPathMaxParkNs' not in flag for flag in c.LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS))
        c.service(0, 'node', 'start', dict(c.COMMON))
        self.assertEqual('1000000', calls[-1][1][p.PARK_ENV])
        c.service(0, 'gateway', 'start', dict(c.COMMON))
        self.assertNotIn(p.PARK_ENV, calls[-1][1])
        self.assertEqual('/fixed-node87', c.RELEASE)
        self.assertEqual('/new-load', c.LOAD_RELEASE)
        p.configure(c, identity)
        c.service(0, 'node', 'start', dict(c.COMMON))
        self.assertEqual('1000000', calls[-1][1][p.PARK_ENV])

    def test_completed_idle_gate_keeps_invalid_prior_attempts_but_requires_all_proofs(self):
        expected = [{'id': str(i)} for i in range(4)]
        retained = [{**task, 'terminal': True, 'configurationVerified': True, 'rawArchiveVerified': True,
                     'analysisVerified': True, 'ownedStopped': True, 'classification': 'INVALID',
                     'terminalCompletedAt': '2026-10-24T01:00:00+00:00',
                     'ownedStoppedAt': '2026-10-24T01:00:01+00:00'} for task in expected]
        class Idle:
            def tasks(self, kind): return expected
        with patch.object(p, 'idle_module', return_value=Idle()):
            plan = {'kind': 'matrix', 'trials': expected}
            completion = {'trials': expected, 'timestamp': '2026-10-24T01:00:02+00:00'}
            self.assertEqual(retained, p.assess_idle_completion(plan, retained, completion))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.assess_idle_completion(plan, retained[:3], completion)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.assess_idle_completion(plan, retained, {**completion, 'trials': expected[::-1]})
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.assess_idle_completion(plan, retained, {**completion, 'timestamp': '2026-10-24T01:00:00+00:00'})
            for name in ('terminal', 'configurationVerified', 'rawArchiveVerified', 'analysisVerified', 'ownedStopped'):
                bad = [{**row} for row in retained]
                bad[2][name] = False
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    p.assess_idle_completion(plan, bad, completion)

    def test_actual_archive_diff_allows_only_capacity_and_mux_families(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td)
            node = load_archive(root / 'node.tar.gz')
            load = load_archive(root / 'load.tar.gz', {
                'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports.class': b'new-mux',
                'io/vectormatch/cluster/RemoteCapacityExperiment$Options.class': b'new-options'})
            class Parent:
                def archive_manifest(self, release): return {}
            class Capacity:
                def frozen_parent(self): return Parent()
            class Idle:
                def capacity_module(self): return Capacity()
            with patch.object(p, 'idle_module', return_value=Idle()):
                diff = p.load_class_diff(node, load)
            self.assertEqual(2, len(diff['changedClusterEntries']))
            self.assertTrue(diff['otherJarEntriesUnchanged'])

    def test_archive_diff_rejects_node_client_or_core_change(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root = Path(td)
            node = load_archive(root / 'node.tar.gz')
            class Parent:
                def archive_manifest(self, release): return {}
            class Capacity:
                def frozen_parent(self): return Parent()
            class Idle:
                def capacity_module(self): return Capacity()
            with patch.object(p, 'idle_module', return_value=Idle()):
                for i, forbidden in enumerate(('io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterNodeMain.class',
                                                'io/vectormatch/cluster/ClusterClient.class')):
                    load = load_archive(root / ('bad%d.tar.gz' % i), {
                        'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports.class': b'new-mux', forbidden: b'bad'})
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        p.load_class_diff(node, load)
                load = load_archive(root / 'bad-core.tar.gz', {
                    'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports.class': b'new-mux'}, core=b'bad-core')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    p.load_class_diff(node, load)

    def test_default_registration_is_draft_and_never_reads_active_idle_raw(self):
        with patch.object(p, 'prerequisites', side_effect=AssertionError('No active result scan')), \
             patch.object(p, 'artifact_inputs', side_effect=AssertionError('No artifact scan')), \
             patch.object(p, 'save_new', side_effect=AssertionError('No write')):
            output = io.StringIO()
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
                register.main([])
            self.assertTrue(json.loads(output.getvalue())['draftOnly'])

    def test_matrix_without_execute_does_not_read_plan_or_connect(self):
        with patch.object(p, 'read', side_effect=AssertionError('No plan read')):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                matrix.main([])

    def test_exclusive_evidence_and_strict_profile_inputs(self):
        for value in (True, '128', 64, 512, 0):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                p.concurrency(value)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            p.tasks('unknown')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            path = Path(td) / 'receipt.json'
            p.save_new(path, {'passed': False})
            before = p.digest(path)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                p.save_new(path, {'passed': True})
            self.assertEqual(before, p.digest(path))
            self.assertFalse(p.read(path)['passed'])

    def test_build_bundle_deploy_helpers_are_draft_without_execute(self):
        for name, function, args in [('build.py', 'build', ['--revision', 'a' * 40]),
                                      ('bundle-load.py', 'bundle', []), ('deploy-load.py', 'deploy', [])]:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mw_helper_' + function, p.BASE / name)
            helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
            with patch.object(helper, function, side_effect=AssertionError('No execution')), \
                 patch('sys.argv', [name, *args]):
                out = io.StringIO()
                with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
                    helper.main(args) if function == 'build' else helper.main()
                self.assertTrue(json.loads(out.getvalue())['draftOnly'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

"""Explicit isolated full Java build of one committed load revision. No SSH or deployment."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import common as p


def build(revision):
    p.require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', revision), 'Full committed load revision required')
    head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=p.WORKSPACE, text=True).strip()
    p.require(head == revision, 'HEAD/explicit source revision changed before build')
    out = p.OUT / 'tool-validation'; out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = p.BASE / ('build-' + revision)
    source_path = p.BASE / ('source-' + revision + '.tar')
    for path in (destination, source_path, p.BASE / 'build.json', out / 'java-build.log', out / 'java-tests.json'):
        p.require(not path.exists(), 'Build evidence/checkout already exists; inspect without overwrite: ' + str(path))
    paths = ['core', 'cluster', 'server', 'projector', 'bench', 'gradle', 'gradlew', 'gradlew.bat',
             'build.gradle.kts', 'settings.gradle.kts', 'gradle.properties', 'deploy', 'scripts']
    archive_command = ['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', revision, '--', *paths]
    raw = subprocess.check_output(archive_command, cwd=p.WORKSPACE)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:') as source:
        members = source.getmembers()
        p.require(source.pax_headers.get('comment') == revision, 'git archive commit metadata differs')
        p.require(len({entry.name for entry in members}) == len(members), 'Duplicate source archive member')
        for entry in members:
            name = PurePosixPath(entry.name)
            p.require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and (entry.isdir() or entry.isfile()), 'Unsafe source archive member')
        destination.mkdir()
        source.extractall(destination)
    with source_path.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(raw)
    info = {'revision': revision, 'root': str(destination), 'source': 'git archive of committed source/build/tool files only',
            'sourceRevisionExplicitlyPinned': True, 'sourceArchiveSha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'sourceArchivePath': str(source_path), 'sourceArchiveCommand': archive_command}
    p.save_new(p.BASE / 'build.json', info)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update({'JAVA_HOME': str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/jdk'),
                        'GRADLE_USER_HOME': str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/gradle-user-home'),
                        'VM_TEST_PG_URL': 'jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:55432/postgres?user=vectormatch'})
    environment['PATH'] = str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/gradle/bin') + ':' + str(p.WORKSPACE / '.tools/jdk/bin') + ':' + environment['PATH']
    command = ['gradle', '--no-daemon', 'test', ':cluster:installDist']
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    print('ISOLATED_MUX_WINDOW_LOAD_BUILD_STARTED', revision, flush=True)
    with (out / 'java-build.log').open('x') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=destination, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    suites = []
    for file in sorted(destination.glob('*/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml')):
        suite = ET.parse(file).getroot()
        suites.append({'suite': suite.attrib['name'], **{key: int(suite.attrib.get(key, 0)) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}})
        target = out / 'java-xml' / file.parent.parent.parent.parent.name / file.name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with target.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(file.read_bytes())
    receipt = {**info, 'startedAt': started, 'completedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'command': command, 'exitCode': result.returncode, 'suites': suites,
               'tests': sum(row['tests'] for row in suites), 'failures': sum(row['failures'] + row['errors'] for row in suites),
               'skipped': sum(row['skipped'] for row in suites),
               'scope': 'Full isolated committed-source Java tests and installDist only; no idle-completion prerequisite, SSH, deployment, registration or cloud load.'}
    p.save_new(out / 'java-tests.json', receipt)
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key != 'suites'}), flush=True)
    print((out / 'java-build.log').read_text()[-4500:], flush=True)
    return result.returncode


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--revision', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'buildExecuted': False, 'sshOrDeployment': False, 'revision': args.revision}))
        return 0
    return build(args.revision)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Package one committed load artifact; do not deploy or register measurements."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import tarfile
import zipfile
import common as p

NODE_REVISION = '87ad09c11807a78d4f8e3b2ad6088e6940e33261'
NODE_BUNDLE = '1317d767d1e6f1cc43320dea284818cc4fa246de7242c275d05408220aa270d0'


def entries(data):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as jar:
        names = jar.namelist()
        p.require(len(names) == len(set(names)), 'Duplicate JAR entry')
        return {name: hashlib.sha256(jar.read(name)).hexdigest()
                for name in names if not name.endswith('/')}


def manifest(release):
    p.require(p.digest(release['archive']) == release['bundleSha256'], 'Bundle SHA changed')
    with tarfile.open(release['archive']) as archive:
        members = archive.getmembers()
        p.require(len({m.name for m in members}) == len(members), 'Duplicate bundle member')
        for item in members:
            name = PurePosixPath(item.name)
            p.require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts
                      and (item.isfile() or item.isdir()), 'Unsafe bundle member')
        result = json.load(archive.extractfile('DEPLOYMENT.json'))
        p.require(result['revision'] == release['revision'], 'Manifest revision differs')
        p.require({m.name for m in members if m.isfile()} == set(result['files']) | {'DEPLOYMENT.json'},
                  'Manifest file set differs')
        for name, expected in result['files'].items():
            p.require(hashlib.sha256(archive.extractfile(name).read()).hexdigest() == expected,
                      'Archived file SHA differs: ' + name)
    return result


def bundle():
    info = p.read(p.BASE / 'build.json'); revision = info['revision']
    tests = p.read(p.OUT / 'tool-validation/java-tests.json')
    p.require(tests['revision'] == revision and tests['exitCode'] == 0
              and tests['failures'] == tests['skipped'] == 0 and tests['tests'] > 0
              and tests['sourceArchiveSha256'] == info['sourceArchiveSha256'], 'Full load build not green')
    p.require(p.digest(info['sourceArchivePath']) == info['sourceArchiveSha256'], 'Build source changed')
    build = Path(info['root'])
    p.require(build.parent == p.BASE and build.name == 'build-' + revision, 'Unexpected build root')
    node = p.read(p.OUT.parent / 'idle/node-release.json')
    p.require(node['revision'] == NODE_REVISION and node['bundleSha256'] == NODE_BUNDLE,
              'Pinned node artifact changed')
    node_manifest = manifest(node)
    stage = p.BASE / ('load-' + revision); archive_path = p.BASE / ('load-' + revision + '.tar.gz')
    for path in (stage, archive_path, p.BASE / 'load-release.json', p.OUT / 'load-release.json',
                 p.OUT / 'load-deployment-manifest.json'):
        p.require(not path.exists(), 'Immutable artifact exists; never overwrite: ' + str(path))
    old = {}
    with tarfile.open(node['archive']) as archive:
        for member in archive.getmembers():
            if member.isfile() and member.name.startswith('dist/cluster/lib/') and member.name.endswith('.jar'):
                old[Path(member.name).name] = entries(archive.extractfile(member).read())
    lib = build / 'cluster/build/install/cluster/lib'
    new = {file.name: entries(file.read_bytes()) for file in lib.glob('*.jar')}
    p.require(old and set(old) == set(new), 'Dependency JAR sets differ')
    families = ('io/vectormatch/cluster/RemoteCapacityExperiment',
                'io/vectormatch/cluster/MultiplexedLoadTransports')
    changed, unchanged = [], {}
    for jar in sorted(new):
        if not jar.startswith('cluster-'):
            p.require(new[jar] == old[jar], 'Unrelated core/dependency changed: ' + jar)
            continue
        for entry in sorted(set(new[jar]) | set(old[jar])):
            if new[jar].get(entry) == old[jar].get(entry):
                unchanged[entry] = new[jar][entry]
            else:
                p.require(any(entry == family + '.class' or entry.startswith(family + '$')
                              for family in families), 'Unrelated cluster bytecode changed: ' + entry)
                changed.append(entry)
    p.require(changed and any('/MultiplexedLoadTransports' in name for name in changed),
              'Expected new multiplexed transport bytecode')
    destination = stage / 'dist/cluster/lib'; destination.mkdir(parents=True)
    for file in sorted(lib.glob('*.jar')): shutil.copyfile(file, destination / file.name)
    for name in ('deploy/remote_service.py', 'deploy/test_remote_service.py',
                 'scripts/capacity-telemetry.py', 'scripts/tests/test_capacity_telemetry.py'):
        destination = stage / name; destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(build / name, destination)
        p.require(p.digest(destination) == node_manifest['files'][name], 'Unrelated launcher/observer changed')
    files = {str(file.relative_to(stage)): p.digest(file) for file in stage.rglob('*') if file.is_file()}
    result = {'revision': revision, 'role': 'capacity-mux-window-load-only',
              'comparedAgainstNodeRevision': NODE_REVISION, 'fixedNodeRevision': NODE_REVISION,
              'fixedNodeBundleSha256': NODE_BUNDLE, 'changedClusterEntries': sorted(changed),
              'unchangedClusterEntriesSha256': unchanged, 'files': files,
              'sourceArchiveSha256': info['sourceArchiveSha256'],
              'scope': 'One new load artifact for both logical128/256 arms, physical1/sharedDriver1. '
                       'Only RemoteCapacityExperiment/MultiplexedLoadTransports class families may differ '
                       'from fixed node87ad; core/NodeMain/ClusterClient/dependencies identical. ZIP timestamps excluded.'}
    p.save_new(stage / 'DEPLOYMENT.json', result)
    with tarfile.open(archive_path, 'w:gz') as archive:
        for file in sorted(stage.iterdir()): archive.add(file, arcname=file.name, recursive=True)
    release = {'revision': revision, 'root': '/opt/vectormatch/optimization-load-releases/' + revision,
               'archive': str(archive_path), 'bundleSha256': p.digest(archive_path),
               'archiveBytes': archive_path.stat().st_size}
    p.require(manifest(release) == result, 'Packaged manifest differs')
    p.save_new(p.BASE / 'load-release.json', release)
    p.save_new(p.OUT / 'load-release.json', release)
    p.save_new(p.OUT / 'load-deployment-manifest.json', result)
    print('IMMUTABLE_MUX_WINDOW_LOAD_BUNDLE_NO_DEPLOYMENT', json.dumps(release), flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true'); args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'noPackagingDeploymentOrRegistration': True})); return
    bundle()


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Upload immutable load bytes to existing node2 only; start no cloud process."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import shlex
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import common as p


def deploy():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mux_window_bundle', p.BASE / 'bundle-load.py')
    package = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(package)
    release = p.read(p.BASE / 'load-release.json'); manifest = package.manifest(release)
    p.require(p.read(p.OUT / 'load-release.json') == release
              and p.read(p.OUT / 'load-deployment-manifest.json') == manifest, 'Archived release differs')
    receipt_path = p.OUT / 'load-upload-receipt.json'
    p.require(not receipt_path.exists(), 'Upload receipt exists; do not redeploy exact job')
    sys.path.insert(0, str(p.BASE.parent.parent / 'runpod-20261023'))
    import remote
    revision = release['revision']; target = '/opt/vectormatch/probe/mux-window-load-' + revision + '.tar.gz'
    result = remote.upload(2, release['archive'], target)
    p.require(result.returncode == 0, 'Load archive upload failed: ' + result.stderr)
    code = 'RELEASE=' + repr(release) + '\nFILES=' + repr(manifest['files']) + '\nTARGET=' + repr(target) + '\n' + '''
import pathlib,hashlib,json,tarfile,subprocess,sys
source=pathlib.Path(TARGET)
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==RELEASE['bundleSha256']
destination=pathlib.Path(RELEASE['root'])
assert not destination.exists(),'Refusing to modify an existing release'
with tarfile.open(source) as archive:
 for item in archive.getmembers():
  name=pathlib.PurePosixPath(item.name)
  assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and (item.isfile() or item.isdir())
 destination.mkdir(parents=True)
 archive.extractall(destination)
for name,expected in FILES.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((destination/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
test=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','test_remote_service.py'],cwd=destination/'deploy',capture_output=True,text=True)
print(json.dumps({'node':2,'verified':True,'loadRevision':RELEASE['revision'],'files':FILES,
 'launcherTest':{'exitCode':test.returncode,'stdout':test.stdout,'stderr':test.stderr},
 'scope':'Immutable load archive verification and launcher unit tests only. No node/load/gateway/PG process start or kernel change.'}))
raise SystemExit(test.returncode)
'''
    result = remote.run(2, 'python3 -B -', input=code, timeout=90)
    p.require(result.returncode == 0, 'Remote byte/test verification failed: ' + result.stdout + result.stderr)
    row = json.loads(result.stdout)
    p.require(row['verified'] is True and row['launcherTest']['exitCode'] == 0, 'Upload not verified')
    receipt = {'timestamp': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'bundleSha256': release['bundleSha256'], 'nodes': [row],
               'sourceSha256': p.digest(Path(__file__)),
               'scope': 'Existing load host node2 only. Fixed node87ad release and running idle experiment untouched; no new resource or process.'}
    p.save_new(receipt_path, receipt)
    print('IMMUTABLE_MUX_WINDOW_LOAD_UPLOAD_VERIFIED_NO_PROCESS_START', revision, flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true'); args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'noSSHOrDeploymentOrRegistration': True})); return
    deploy()


if __name__ == '__main__': main()
